==Pocket Monsters TV Special: Masara Town Arc Recap==
The first episode in this series of clip show OVAs had four segments.
 

==Who's That New Pokémon? Saturday==
During this Pokémon: Advanced special preview event, Get the Show on the Road! and A Ruin with a View were aired on Kids' WB as a one-hour special. Leading into and out of commercial breaks, special eyecatches were shown showcasing Generation III Pokémon. Unlike traditional Who's That Pokémon? segments, two Pokémon are featured at once, and the viewer is not presented with a silhouette or the question. Instead, simply tells them the names of the featured Pokémon.
 

==The Power of Us pre-show==
In American theaters, the pre-show for Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us had exclusive Who's That Pokémon? segments interspersed between other clips and advertisements.
 

==Official web sites==
===Pokémon: The First Movie site===
The Warner Bros. site for Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back had a game called Pokémon Pop Quiz, where Brock asked the player several sets of three questions, the first and third of which were Who's That Pokémon?
 

==Official social media outlets==
===The Pokémon Company International===
Facebook posts and tweets of Who's That Pokémon? were also published officially, showing a silhouette and revealing it the following day.
 

===Pokémon GO===
The official Facebook and Twitter of Pokémon GO briefly published Who's That Pokémon? segments. A short video clip of the Pokémon's silhouette in the game was posted, and the Pokémon would be revealed in an image posted the next day.
 

===Pokémon Detective Pikachu===
The official Facebook and Twitter of , as well as the official Instagram of , have published Who's That Pokémon? segments in the form of short videos, showing a silhouette and revealing it after a few seconds. The video descriptions include hints.
 

==Related articles==
